description: Spacious Parisian apartment, located in the heart of the 16th district: a few steps from the Arc du Triomphe. It can accommodate 8 travellers and has 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a spacious living room.This 1st floor accommodation offers a bright and warmly decorated space. Families and friends will be able to spend a convivial moment in the heart of the historic centre of Paris.The metros 1,2,6 and buses will allow you to quickly access all the iconic areas of Paris.More information below :)The space✧THE HIGHLIGHTS ✧WIFI availableFully equipped kitchenBed and bath linen provided❋❋ KITCHEN AREA ❋❋- Oven- Microwave- Refrigerator, freezer- Dishwasher- Toaster- Kettle- Expresso coffee machine- Cooking plate- Washing machine and dryer❋❋ LIVING ROOM AREA ❋❋- One TV - Two sofas- An iron❋❋ 2 BATHROOMS ❋❋- Shower with toilet- Bathtub - Hair dryer- Separated WC4 BEDROOMS ❋❋❋- 2 beds 140 x 200- 2 beds 160 x 200- Baby bed (we do not provide sheets for the baby bed)aGuest accessA checker from the Wehost team will greet you in front of the building at the scheduled time, hence the importance of scheduling your arrival time with us, at least 24 hours before your arrival. Travelers will have access to the entire accommodation.Other things to noteFor travelers wishing to arrive after 8:00 p.m. I will ask them for an additional contribution of 24 € to give on Airbnb for a friend who will come, give you the keys and show you around the apartment.✘ No smokers✘ No pets✘ Parties STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.We will ask you to respect the cleaning teams and to leave the accommodation in a correct state. In case of abuse, a supplement may be requested.Please note that we will not accept bookings made for a third party. Thank you for your understanding.
